version.description: Format version, MAJOR.MINOR, shared with the script format. See docs/script-format.md.

name.description: What to call this runner in output. Defaults to the file's name.

executable.description: The program that launches an implementation, for example ruby or python3.

arguments.description: Arguments the runner always passes, before the ones naming the program to run.

env.description: Environment the runner needs. Merged with the script's own env, which wins where the two name the same variable.

inheritEnv.description: Put prescript's own environment underneath the declared env. Set by either the runner or the script.
